units.source_text: 他游手好闲，无所事事，不辞劳苦地登上山来，可以认为这是一种典型的徒劳。

en.t: As an idle man with nothing to do, his laborious climb up the mountain for no real purpose could be seen as a perfect example of futile effort.

units.source_text: 正因为如此，这里边还有一种虚幻的魅力。

en.t: Precisely for that reason, there was also a kind of illusory charm in it.
